flows.name: 导出全部健康数据（发起）
flows.description: 中文界面。启动「健康」，在「摘要」页打开右上角「资料」，滚动到底部，点「导出所有健康数据」，在系统确认框按「导出」（原生 alert 路径；该弹窗不一定出现在元素树里，所以不用 wait_for 等它）。手机随后打包 zip（约 1 分钟）并弹出共享面板；接着运行 health/save-export-to-files-zh-cn，或读取 /agent/elements 自行处理。任一标签缺失或重复时不会点击（fail-closed）。

flows.name: Export all Health data (request)
flows.description: English UI. Launch Health, open the profile page from the Summary tab, scroll to the bottom, tap 'Export All Health Data', and press 'Export' on the system alert through the native alert route (the alert does not reliably appear in the element tree, so no wait_for gates it). The phone then packs a zip (~1 minute) and shows the share sheet; continue with health/save-export-to-files. Locators use Health's stable accessibility identifiers where they exist; only the Profile button and the alert button are label-based. Fails closed if a label is missing or ambiguous. Hardware-proven in zh-CN as health/export-all-zh-cn; the English labels still need a run.

flows.name: 导出后「替换现有项目」选保留两者
flows.description: 仅在 health/save-export-to-files-zh-cn 之后弹出「替换现有项目」系统弹窗时运行：按「保留两者」，然后确认「文件」选位置页已关闭、回到「健康」资料页。没有弹窗时不会动作（fail-closed）。

flows.name: Open Health
flows.description: Launch Apple Health and wait until the app is in the foreground.

flows.name: 把健康数据导出存到「文件」
flows.description: 中文界面。在 health/export-all-zh-cn 之后运行：等共享面板出现（打包约 1 分钟；面板出现前本 flow 会在第 1 步超时，稍后重跑即可），点「保存到“文件”」，再按「文件」选位置页右上角的「保存」。这一页的辅助功能树很重，WDA 读取经常超时，所以「保存」用屏幕右上角坐标 (0.89, 0.096) 点按，并以选位置页的「保存」按钮消失作为后置条件（保存成功或弹出替换提示都满足）。zip 存到上次使用的位置（默认 iCloud云盘 根目录，Mac 上在 ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/ 同步出现，文件名 导出.zip）。如果最后一步超时且屏幕上是「替换现有项目」系统弹窗（该位置已有同名文件），运行 health/export-keep-both。

flows.name: Save Health export to Files
flows.description: English UI. Run after health/export-all once the share sheet is visible (the zip takes ~1 minute; this flow times out on step 1 until then — rerun). Taps 'Save to Files', then the Files picker's Save button. That picker's accessibility tree is heavy and WDA source reads often time out, so Save is a top-right coordinate tap (0.89, 0.096) guarded by a postcondition: the picker's Save button is gone (true after a save and while a replace prompt covers it). If the last step times out and a 'Replace Existing Item?' alert is showing, answer it with the native alert route (Keep Both), as health/export-keep-both does in zh-CN. English labels still need a run; the zh-CN twin is hardware-proven.

flows.name: Open Settings
flows.description: Launch the Settings app by bundle id and wait until it is in the foreground.

flows.name: Go Home
flows.description: Return to the Home Screen. Use it to reset the phone to a known state before another flow.

flows.name: Open Spotlight
flows.description: Return home, open Spotlight, and require its text field before finishing.

flows.name: Spotlight search
flows.description: Return home, open Spotlight, type the query supplied for this run, and submit it. Spotlight opens the top hit (an app, contact, or web result), so read /agent/elements afterwards to see where you landed.

apps.name: Apple Health
apps.description: Apple Health has no API. These flows drive the app UI to export or read on-phone health data.

apps.name: iOS system (Home Screen, Spotlight)
apps.description: Flows that only use system surfaces: Home, Spotlight search, app launch. Locale-independent.
